The '''JV-Z1/D butler droid''' was a model of [[Butler droid/Legends|butler droid]] produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] centuries prior to the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Design==
The JV-Z1/D was a short [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]],<ref name="EGTD" /> standing 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="FF36" /> and was designed with an intentional slouch that implied subservience in the unit. The droid's head was fitted with an [[infrared lintscope]], a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] that gave the unit a genteel-sounding voice, and an internal database filled with cultured minutiae including how to correctly fold an [[Oseoni greatcoat]]. Each JV-Z1/D unit was plated in a burnished veneer of silver [[Chromite/Legends|chromite]].<ref name="EGTD" />

==Role==
The JV-Z1/D was designed to serve their owners and obey their commands. Like all butler droids, they were patient and subservient with a polite and  cultured manner.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
Manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]], the JV-Z1/D was introduced to the droid market several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to take advantage of the growing fad among the wealthy for [[Butler droid/Legends|butler droids]].<ref name="EGTD" />

[[File:ZeeZee.jpg|thumb|right|180px|ZZ-4Z]]
One JV-Z1/D droid known to be in operation following the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was the centuries-old [[ZZ-4Z]], who became the property of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during his time on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. When Solo left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a series of adventures that would soon lead him to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], ZZ-4Z remained to maintain his master's apartment. The droid was still operating when Solo returned over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, though was destroyed in a firefight between his master and a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="EGTD" />
